scope: Task design and author-side acceptance evidence; no automatic changes to historical verdicts, admission records or agent scoring.
full_trajectories: At least one continuous generated success witness for scoped design feasibility; reuse existing evidence with checked representation mappings. Additional robustness trajectories are separate; none is mandatory per random draw.

levels.task: Representative complete physical successes establish the recorded configurations can be completed; no universal random-range claim.
levels.skill: Demonstrate high-level-to-low-level refinement and low-level-to-trajectory realization in a declared case. Continuous applicability domains and arbitrary-start skill composition are separate extensions; uncalibrated envelopes remain null.
levels.instance: Budgeted identity, reachability, collision, support/load, transition and time checks, with targeted short physics probes when necessary.
levels.execution: Generate the current local segment from observations and replan; retain original action-interface, physical and scoring constraints.

rejected.whole_instance_requirement: A route-independent necessary-condition counterexample; failure of one route or solver is insufficient.

checkpoint_rule: Independently restored or constructed starts are local diagnostics. They do not establish continuous full-task success or arbitrary skill composition.

sampling.self_generated: May preferentially sample evidenced skill envelopes, with declared filters and retained draw/rejection records.
sampling.benchmark: Retain every prescribed random sample and its result; do not silently exclude unknowns/failures or replace failed seeds.
sampling.subset_reports: Require a predeclared selection rule, full sampling ledger, separate state counts and explicit denominators.
sampling.representative_cohort: Choose a finite risk-based cohort and rationale before execution; consider boundaries, interiors and contact changes. No universal minimum of five complete seeds per layer.
sampling.existing_explicit_cohorts: Remain in force until separately revised; this policy does not cancel ongoing finite acceptance work.

acceptance.repeat_scope: Separate repeatability/formal reproduction reporting for preselected representative seeds. Not a prerequisite for the one-witness design-feasibility gate and not required for every screened random instance.
acceptance.human_review: Applicable declared representative full runs and critical positive/negative clips; static screening needs no video; headless evidence cannot be signed as video-reviewed.
acceptance.independent_reproduction: Declared representative solutions, not every random screening sample.

implementation_boundary: This file defines evidence requirements. It does not implement a geometric/dynamic feasibility solver, budget scheduler, status inference engine or automatic admission migration.
agent_visibility: Author routes and privileged evidence must be excluded from agent-visible bundles.

rules: Keep scoped task completion and publication separate from skill and instance readiness.
Use finite representative full witnesses; no per-random-instance full-solution prerequisite.
Validate skill applicability and actual-state transitions; gaps remain unknown.
Preserve every prescribed benchmark draw, failure, rejection and timeout; declare self-generated sampling filters.
Generate local trajectories during execution; full trajectories are additional representative evidence.
No automatic promotion of formal admission or screening passes.
